# Coding agents

Coding agents tend to write Pages as if it were a Node framework, or as if it were the 0.x npm package. The `pocketone` Agent Skill teaches them Pages: `pb_pages/`, `ctx`, routing, templates, layouts, auth and deploying, alongside the binary, `pocketone.yaml` and its extensions. It carries these docs and the spec, so it changes when they change.

**Claude Code**

```
/plugin marketplace add pocketonehq/pocketone
/plugin install pocketone@pocketone
```

**Other agents that read Agent Skills** (Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI and others)

```bash
npx skills add pocketonehq/pocketone
```

Or copy [`agent/skills/pocketone`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/tree/main/agent/skills/pocketone) into your project.

## llms.txt

- [pocketone.dev/llms.txt](/llms.txt) indexes every docs page, the Pages docs included, with a one-line summary.
- [pocketone.dev/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt) holds every docs page in one Markdown file.
